newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares fall, big interest in Storebrand.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares fall, big interest in Storebrand.

text.p: Large foreign buying in Norway's largest insurer Storebrand and positive sentiment in the banking sector lifted the finance indices on the Oslo bourse on Friday, but overall investors were playing cautiously, dealers said.
"Sentiment is nervous and therefore everyone's playing a wait-and-see game," said one broker. "But I think the bottom is just around the corner. I don't think we're going to have any major slide."
The Total share index came off 1.31 percent to end the week at 1,064.29 points in turnover of 1.34 billion crowns.
Storebrand accounted for 561 million crowns of the session's trade, with a large block of 8.32 million shares moving in a single off-exchange trade. The stock advanced 0.90 crowns to 45.10 crowns.

"I have been in contact with a foreign broker, who has asked me to find large blocks of shares in Storebrand," said one dealer. "He said there was one overseas investor who wants to buy up to 10 percent (in the company)."
